reportedCase: Wikipedia create account / login / How to log in lose context or show zero-click estimates

iterations.finding: Popup click-intent publication still checked destination.value; changed it to the same contextual-task predicate used by continuation.
Wikipedia entry links server-redirect to a different authentication origin. The prior expected URL/origin never represented that final destination.

An authentication page heading was incorrectly inherited by unrelated appearance forms, producing multiple candidate forms. Form-local evidence or password/input-type and submit metadata are now required.

Playwright's fulfilled redirect did not route the follow-up to the intended fixture; the Vite demo was observed instead. Replaced this fixture with an actual local HTTP server and retained the assertions.
A reported 49.3-minute timeout occurred despite the 30-second test timeout. Its precise timing cause was not established; subsequent normal-duration runs remained subject to the unchanged timeout.

Real server redirect/continuation and unrelated-navigation refusal passed. All four live login/account entry and independent form-semantics checks passed at both widths. Native permission grant and live coach activation beyond that grant remain manual checks.

The existing narrow geometry test had no selected control at its first guide call. A targeted rerun passed with unchanged assertions/timeouts; the precise transient cause was not established. Failed report and trace are archived as auth-before-geometry-live-regressions.json and output/qa/auth-before-geometry-live.
